summary_1line: Krishna reveals a terrifying cosmic form in the Kuru court, departs unharmed, then informs Kunti, who urges Yudhishthira to fulfill his warrior duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna laughs in the Kuru court as countless thumb-sized radiant gods emerge from his blazing body while kings recoil in terror.
From Krishna’s body burst flames and sparks as Brahma appears on his forehead and Rudra on his chest while celestial beings pour forth.
Krishna steps out of the trembling court toward his white chariot with tinkling bells while astonished kings follow behind him.
